reasoning: This glyph depicts three staggered vertical columns of blocks, which is standard UI chrome for toggling a masonry grid view or representing an abstract multi-column layout. Because it shows an interface layout mode rather than a concrete real-world object and is easily confused with bar charts or abstract geometric blocks at small sizes, it fails as a glanceable task icon.
